company.name: 100 WASH Solutions
company.shortDescription: 100 WASH Solutions treat all water problems (salinity - turbidity - odor and impurities).
company.description:
100 WASH Solutions is a leading provider of water treatment and purification services. Founded in 2018, the company has quickly become a trusted name in the industry and a go-to provider of safe drinking water. 
The company offers a wide range of services, from water filtration and purification to wastewater treatment and desalination. They use the latest technologies and equipment to ensure their customers have access to clean and safe water. 
In addition, 100 WASH Solutions also offers maintenance and repair services for their products. This ensures that customers have peace of mind knowing their water treatment systems are in good condition and are running properly. 
The company is committed to providing the highest level of customer service and satisfaction. They are dedicated to delivering timely and effective solutions to their customers’ water treatment needs. 
Overall, 100 WASH Solutions is a trusted name in the industry and a go-to provider of water treatment services. Their knowledgeable staff and quality products ensure that customers have access to clean and safe drinking water.
